Apple Should Rally 11% From Here: Bonus White Paper By Chris Versace and Bob Lang | Mar 14, 2018 | 9:00 AM EDT 0 
Apple (AAPL) has risen by about 6.8% so far in 2018 -- impressive for less than three months, but underperforming the Nasdaq Composite index's roughly 8.8% YTD gain. However, AAPL shares have gained 31.3% over the past year, beating the Nasdaq's 27.8% increase over the same period. 
That's quite a 12-month gain, but it naturally leads investors to wonder whether there's any additional upside to be had with Apple shares.
